ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A broom remains a concrete sweeping implement, but Chan cases make its handling part of the answer. Shide puts it down and stands with folded hands when asked his name, then picks it up and sweeps when asked again; Yunyan raises his broom when Daowu challenges his sweeping, and later masters replay the gesture and propose replies to it.
EvidenceBody: The Shide case preserves two answering actions with the same object: he puts the broom down and stands when asked his identity, then picks it up and sweeps when the question is repeated.
In the Yunyan–Daowu case, Daowu calls sweeping too busy; Yunyan says one should know there is one who is not busy and raises the broom when Daowu asks whether that makes a second moon.
Tianyin Yuanxiu replays the case and says that when Yunyan raises the broom he would answer “exactly,” leaving Yunyan nowhere to put it.

Other case comments call for a dungpan and broom after an exchange is judged soiled. Xueguan Zhiyin expands the implement into a sermon image—binding empty space into a broom and sweeping buddhas, patriarchs, ordinary and holy—but still calls it a broom held and left behind.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The sweeping implement becomes an answering gesture and a commentator’s implement for clearing away what an exchange has left soiled.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Occurrences inside “broom-star” are substring matches for a different compound and do not establish another sense of the standalone broom.

ComparedThings: Shide’s broom, Yunyan’s raised broom, the requested dungpan-and-broom, and Xueguan’s impossible empty-space broom all retain the same implement even when handled figuratively
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Shide’s broom, Yunyan’s raised broom, the requested dungpan-and-broom, and Xueguan’s impossible empty-space broom all retain the same implement even when handled figuratively.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Broom, sweeping, raise, put down, dungpan, and fetch expose the object and the concrete actions that make it answer-bearing in the cases.

FamilyControls.reason: 拈掃帚, 放下掃帚, and 豎起掃帚 are action variants around the implement. 糞箕 is its paired tool, not an alternate target.
